 BGMI Air Opens Pre-Registrations for iOS Ahead of December Launch
 Releasing soon.
 By   Aritra Bhowmick   
 Updated: Nov. 11, 2026, 7:19 p.m. 
 Related reads: BGMI: Krafton India Reveals Upcoming 4.7 Update Details, Including Popularity Battle Annual Gala, and More 
 Krafton India has opened pre-registrations for iOS users for its upcoming mobile battle royale game, BGMI Air. More like this BGMI 4.7 Update Features Arctic Chronicles, Erangel Subzero Mode, and Snow Festival 
BGMI Air is now available for pre-registration on the App Store , following its earlier availability on the Google Play Store . The game has already crossed 14 million pre-registrations on Android and is scheduled for release on December 10, 2026.
 Players interested in trying out the game can also participate in a closed beta test ahead of its December launch . The test is scheduled to take place from November 20 to 24, 2026, across Mumbai, Delhi, and Kolkata.
 For those unfamiliar with the title, BGMI Air is a lighter version of the original battle royale game, built for low-spec devices. The game has a download size of around 1GB and aims to reach players who may have been unable to play BGMI because of device or storage limitations.
 In other news, Krafton India has also revealed details about the upcoming BGMI 4.7 update , which will introduce the Arctic Chronicles-themed mode, Erangel Subzero mode, new cold-weather gear, vehicles, and more.
